title: Beyond Accuracy: Prefix-Invariant Realizations of Low-Precision Fast Matrix Multiplication
abstract: arXiv:2609.39816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast matrix multiplication saves multiplications through exact cancellation, but rounding sums that mix token rows can leave contributions from later tokens in earlier language model outputs. This threatens prefix invariance, which multiple-choice likelihood scoring relies on: a scored likelihood must depend only on its allowed prefix. On Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, two fast FP8 realizations repaired to ordinary-looking accuracy still change the answers chosen by likelihood on 5.83% and 10.00% of 240 OpenBookQA items when only the text after the allowed prefix is replaced with the bf16 model's own greedy continuation. Both row-local controls, the bf16 model and a deployed FP8 matrix multiplication kernel, change none. Accuracy thus does not certify prefix invariance, and the stability criteria we analyze cannot tell realizations apart: across all 512 sign variants of two-level Strassen they stay constant while teacher-forced perplexities span

translated_title: 超越准确率：低精度快速矩阵乘法的前缀不变实现
translated_abstract: 快速矩阵乘法通过精确相消来减少乘法次数，但对混合了多个 token 行的求和进行舍入，可能使后续 token 的贡献残留在语言模型较早的输出中。这威胁到前缀不变性——多选题似然评分所依赖的性质：被评分的似然必须只依赖于其允许的前缀。在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上，两种经修复达到表面上正常准确率的快速 FP8 实现，当仅把允许前缀之后的文本替换为 bf16 模型自身的贪心续写时，仍在 240 个 OpenBookQA 题目中分别改变 5.83% 和 10.00% 的题目的似然所选择的答案。而两个行局部对照——bf16 模型和已部署的 FP8 矩阵乘法内核——均未改变任何答案。因此，准确率并不能证明前缀不变性，且我们分析的各种稳定性判据也无法区分不同实现：在两级 Strassen 的全部 512 个符号变体上，这些判据保持恒定，而教师强制困惑度的跨度却……
tldr: 该论文发现，即使在准确率上表现正常，低精度快速矩阵乘法实现仍可能破坏语言模型多选题评分所依赖的前缀不变性并改变模型答案，证明准确率不足以作为此类实现的认证标准。
en_tdlr: Even when repaired to ordinary-looking accuracy, low-precision fast matrix multiplication realizations can break the prefix invariance that multiple-choice likelihood scoring relies on and change model answers, showing that accuracy alone cannot certify such implementations.
